///- --package . --timeout 2400000
open xml_codec

prototype to_text t : t -> string

inl text_node forall t {to_text}. (name : string) (v : t) : xml.xml_node =
    xml.element name [] (xml.text_children (to_text v))

inl optional_text_nodes forall t {to_text}. (name : string) (v : option t) : list xml.xml_node =
    xml.option_list (optionm.map (text_node name) v)

inl repeated_text_nodes forall t {to_text}. (name : string) (vs : list t) : list xml.xml_node =
    listm.map (text_node name) vs

nominal lexical t = { value : t; text : string }

instance to_text lexical t = fun x => x.text

inl lexical_of forall t. (text : string) (value : option t) : option (lexical t) =
    optionm.map (fun v => lexical { value = v; text = text }) value

inl whole_of (text : string) : option i64 =
    if sm'.index_of "." text >= 0i32 then None
    else optionm.map (fun (d : decimal.decimal) => d.units) (decimal.parse text)

inl whole_at_least (least : i64) (text : string) : option i64 =
    match whole_of text with
    | Some n => if n >= least then Some n else None
    | None => None

inl boolean_of (text : string) : option bool =
    match xml.collapsed_space text with
    | "true" => Some true
    | "1" => Some true
    | "false" => Some false
    | "0" => Some false
    | _ => None

type xsd_non_negative_integer = lexical i64

inl xsd_non_negative_integer_of_string (s : string) : option xsd_non_negative_integer =
    lexical_of s (whole_at_least 0i64 s)

inl xsd_non_negative_integer_example (_ : i32) : xsd_non_negative_integer = lexical { value = 1i64; text = "1" }

inl xsd_non_negative_integer_example_text (_ : i32) : string = "1"

let rec x_audit_file_of_children
    (attributes : list (string * string)) (children : list xml.xml_node)
    : result (x_audit_file) (list xml_codec.decode_error)
    =
    inl errors = []
    inl o_header, errors = xml_codec.read_required "Header" x_audit_file_header_of_xml children errors
    inl o_master_files, errors = xml_codec.read_required "MasterFiles" x_audit_file_master_files_of_xml children errors
    inl v_general_ledger_entries, errors =
        xml_codec.read_optional "GeneralLedgerEntries" x_audit_file_general_ledger_entries_of_xml children errors
    inl v_source_documents, errors =
        xml_codec.read_optional "SourceDocuments" x_audit_file_source_documents_of_xml children errors
    xml_codec.decoded_by errors fun () =>
        x_audit_file {
            header = xml_codec.present o_header
            master_files = xml_codec.present o_master_files
            general_ledger_entries = v_general_ledger_entries
            source_documents = v_source_documents
        }

and let x_audit_file_of_xml (c : xml.xml_node) : result (x_audit_file) (list xml_codec.decode_error) =
    x_audit_file_of_children (xml.element_attributes c) (xml.element_children c)

and let x_audit_file_source_documents_of_children
    (attributes : list (string * string)) (children : list xml.xml_node)
    : result (x_audit_file_source_documents) (list xml_codec.decode_error)
    =
    inl errors = []
    inl v_sales_invoices, errors =
        xml_codec.read_optional "SalesInvoices" x_audit_file_source_documents_sales_invoices_of_xml children errors
    inl v_movement_of_goods, errors =
        xml_codec.read_optional "MovementOfGoods" x_audit_file_source_documents_movement_of_goods_of_xml children errors
    inl v_working_documents, errors =
        xml_codec.read_optional
            "WorkingDocuments"
            x_audit_file_source_documents_working_documents_of_xml
            children
            errors
    inl v_payments, errors =
        xml_codec.read_optional "Payments" x_audit_file_source_documents_payments_of_xml children errors
    xml_codec.decoded_by errors fun () =>
        x_audit_file_source_documents {
            sales_invoices = v_sales_invoices
            movement_of_goods = v_movement_of_goods
            working_documents = v_working_documents
            payments = v_payments
        }

and let x_audit_file_source_documents_of_xml
    (c : xml.xml_node)
    : result (x_audit_file_source_documents) (list xml_codec.decode_error)
    =
    x_audit_file_source_documents_of_children (xml.element_attributes c) (xml.element_children c)

and let x_audit_file_source_documents_payments_of_children
    (attributes : list (string * string)) (children : list xml.xml_node)
    : result (x_audit_file_source_documents_payments) (list xml_codec.decode_error)
    =
    inl errors = []
    inl o_number_of_entries, errors =
        xml_codec.read_required
            "NumberOfEntries"
            (xml_codec.read_value xsd_non_negative_integer_of_string)

            inl parses = generated_fiscal_runtime.insert_run (parsed_at - start) parses
            inl writes = generated_fiscal_runtime.insert_run (written_at - parsed_at) writes
            runs (left - 1i32) parses writes (bytes + sm'.length written)
        | _ => failwith "one AuditFile element"
